messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: SLO_LATENCY_P99_BURN
incident-bot: summary: p99 for /v1/generate = 1.2s (SLO 600ms), p95 = 520ms; region: us-west; affected pool: gpu-pool-3
incident-bot: pagerduty link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC1234567

alex: acked. oncall alex here, pulling dashboards + logs.

mike: seeing the spike too, started ~90s ago. autoscaler metrics show no new nodes added in that window. GPU utilization for pool3 is 98%.

sarah: kvcache eviction rate jumped x10 at the same time, small items evicting rapidly — possible cache thrash after recent config change?

alex: hypothesis: KV cache thrash -> increased model token generation due to cold KV lookups -> runtime hot path saturates. Trying quick mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant 2) disable expensive prefix caching policy 3) increase pool target by +2 nodes if autoscaler allows.

mike: I can flip the routing flag. rolling update will affect ~10% of requests initially. Running command now:

```
# prod control plane
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/proxy/route/update \
 -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"redwood-alpha-2","traffic_shift_pct":10}' \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROD_TOKEN"
```

mike: API returned 202, change queued. watching metrics.

sarah: kvcache evictions (per-min):
```
2026-03-14T18:20:00Z evictions=1200
2026-03-14T18:21:00Z evictions=11500
2026-03-14T18:22:00Z evictions=9800
```
sarah: mem pressure on host nodes rose right before the evictions. There's also an inbound traffic spike for route /v1/batch-embed-legacy from a customer key ending in ..9f2.

alex: good catch. mike, can you temp-rate-limit that customer key at the edge? set soft qps to 5 for key ..9f2 and add 429-warn header.

mike: doing it now:
```
kubectl exec edge-rate-limit -n prod -- rate-limit set --key=acct-9f2 --qps=5 --mode=soft
```
mike: applied. logs show the first 429s ~10s after.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by alex at 2123456794. Next escalation in 10m if no progress.

eva: reaching out to support to prep a heads-up for impacted customers (likely minimal error rate but higher latencies). drafting message.

alex: dashboards: after routing change and rate-limit, p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 780ms in ~45s. still above SLO but trending down. continuing mitigations: 1) ask autoscaler to force-add 2 nodes to pool3 2) temporarily lower default batch size to reduce per-request latency.

mike: forced scale executed: autoscaler api returned OK; new nodes provisioning.

```
# autoscaler command
POST /autoscaler/pool/gpu-pool-3/scale?add=2
{"status":"accepted","eta":"45s"}
```
jordan: (cc next oncall) I'm available to take handoff in ~25m. if this isn't healed by then i'll join.

alex: notes for handoff -> cause suspected: rapid KV eviction after config push + sudden customer burst; mitigations applied: route fallback enabled (10%), acct-9f2 soft-rate-limited, autoscaler forced +2 nodes, temporary batch-size lowered. current impact: p95 ~= 420ms, p99 ~= 760ms, error rate unchanged.

sarah: leaving this graph link: https://dashboards.prod/kvcache/evictions?p=pool3&from=now-10m

eva: support update sent to customers in effected orgs; monitoring for replies.

mike: logs showing some model OOMs earlier, likely from mix of larger batches + cache misses. root cause still needs post-incident RCA.

alex: agreed. will keep thread updated. if p99 stays <800ms and autoscaler finishes, i'll start handoff to jordan at 2123457005 with detailed notes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: scheduled escalation check in 10m. If unacknowledged by L2, will escalate to oncall-lead.

jordan: acked the planned handoff time. standing by to review RCA next steps.

alex: thanks team. leaving a short runbook pointer for whoever continues: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/latency-p99-burn — follow steps: identify offending keys, check KV eviction + mem, fallback routing, force scale, customer throttles, preserve audit logs.

mike: final note: keep an eye on eu-west; we saw a small correlated bump but not SLO burn there.

alex: closing interim update — will update when handing off. :thumbsup:
